# Identity denylist for the packed-artifact scan (scripts/pack-verify.sh, stage 3).
#
# ERE patterns, one per line. Comments (#) and blank lines are stripped by the
# loader. The scan is case-insensitive.
#
# PURPOSE: SpyCode never names the underlying models or providers on any
# user-facing surface - only SpyCore's own model names (charon, styx, hermes,
# minos, hephaestus) and the BYOK providers the user configures themselves
# (openai, anthropic, gemini, together, groq is NOT one of them) may appear.
# A packed artifact containing any of the patterns below has leaked an
# underlying identity and must fail the pack gate.
#
# NOTE: provider names a user can legitimately configure (openai, anthropic,
# gemini, together) are DELIBERATELY absent - they are user-chosen BYOK
# configuration, not underlying identities.

qwen
kimi
moonshot
deepseek
groq
mistral
llama
